features.name: Adopt the DCNET harness
features.description: Add feature_list.json, progress.md, init.sh, session-handoff.md, docs/specs + docs/plans, and an AGENTS.md routing pointer so any session or machine restarts deterministically.
features.evidence: ./init.sh exit 0 (2026-09-10): bash -n on 3 scripts; feature_list 5 features / 1 in-progress; settings.yaml default opencode-go/deepseek-flash + dsh --profile headless --dump-config composes; 6 skill bundles; shellcheck clean. validate-harness.mjs 100/100, bottleneck none.

features.name: Seed the OKF knowledge bundle
features.description: Create knowledge/ (OKF v0.1: index + log + per-directory indexes) with concepts for the repo's conventions, decisions, systems, domain glossary, runbooks and gotchas.
features.evidence: knowledge/ (2026-09-10): index.md + log.md + 6 category indexes + 18 concepts (3 conventions, 3 decisions, 3 systems, 1 domain, 3 runbooks, 5 gotchas); all internal links resolve (link check).

features.name: CI runs the verification gate on push
features.description: Add a GitHub Actions workflow that runs ./init.sh on push and pull request, so the offline baseline cannot rot between sessions. Doctor's live-inference check stays out of CI (no key in the runner).
features.evidence: ./init.sh exit 0 (2026-09-10) with the new CI guard; GitHub Actions run 34457516258 on a5d29af -> success in 9s, no annotations; negative tests: dropping the ./init.sh step, dropping the PyYAML step, or adding a secrets reference each fail the gate, with and without PyYAML on PATH.

features.name: Script the ponytail skill update
features.description: skills/README.md documents a manual copy of upstream SKILL.md files. Add scripts/update-ponytail.sh that fetches a pinned upstream release and diffs it, so the update is repeatable instead of hand-run.

features.name: doctor.sh --json for automation
features.description: Give scripts/doctor.sh a machine-readable mode (one JSON object, stable keys) so init.sh, CI, or a setup script can consume the readiness result instead of parsing coloured text.
